name: OpenRouter Usage
description: Track OpenRouter credits and runway from Orca: daily spend by model, token mix, an activity heatmap, per-key spend and limits, budgets, CSV exports and a status bar balance. Read-only; your management key stays in Orca's encrypted secret store.

cover.alt: OpenRouter Usage: one input fanning out to several models, with the title and the features Credits and burn rate, Models, API keys, and Activity and token mix

screenshots.alt: The Usage view: credits left in a violet banner, a closable runway warning, today and this month with budget progress, and a one-colour daily spend chart
screenshots.caption: Credits first, detail on demand

screenshots.alt: A selected day: the chart dims the other bars while Models and Token mix show that day only
screenshots.caption: Pick a day to see its models and tokens

screenshots.alt: The Keys tab with its own 7D, 30D and All switch, per-key spend, limit meters and only the badges that need attention
screenshots.caption: Per-key spend with its own range

screenshots.alt: Token mix as four numbers with cache hit and prompt-to-output ratio, above a 26-week activity heatmap
screenshots.caption: Token mix and 26 weeks of activity

screenshots.alt: The Settings tab: connection with test, replace and disconnect, refresh and alert thresholds, budgets, status bar and BYOK switches
screenshots.caption: Verify your key and tune alerts

settings.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
settings.description: How often the worker polls OpenRouter in the background.

settings.title: Low balance alert (USD)
settings.description: Notify and warn in the status bar when credits left drop below this. 0 turns it off.

settings.title: Daily budget (USD)
settings.description: Notify once per day when today's spend passes this. 0 turns it off.

settings.title: Monthly budget (USD)
settings.description: Warn when actual or projected UTC-month spend exceeds this. 0 turns it off; usage is never blocked.

settings.title: Desktop notifications
settings.description: Notify when credits run low or the daily budget is passed.

settings.title: Show credits in the status bar
Status bar shows
settings.description: What the status bar item says next to your credits left.

settings.title: Count BYOK usage in spend
settings.description: Include requests made with your own provider keys in the spend figures.

settings.title: Banner style
settings.description: How the credits banner at the top of the panel looks.
